_comment: Three ways to connect — pick ONE and delete the rest. All of them need a running TriliumNext instance and an ETAPI token (Trilium: Options -> ETAPI -> Create token), or set TRILIUM_PASSWORD instead and BrainLLM mints one on first start and caches it.

BrainLLM (npm)._comment: Simplest. Needs bun >= 1.0 on PATH — the server uses Bun APIs and does not run on node.

BrainLLM (local build)._comment: For working on BrainLLM itself. Use the real absolute path to your built bundle.

BrainLLM (remote)._comment: A hosted deploy over HTTP. For claude.ai / Claude mobile / Cowork, use their connector UI with OAuth instead — those surfaces cannot send a static bearer token, which is what BRAINLLM_OWNER_PASSWORD enables.
